title: Renewal Wildfire Simulation & Playbook (Q2 2027) - Compact Tracker
summary: Compact simulation-style tracker to run a 'wildfire' renewal outreach sprint: prioritize accounts by contagion risk, test three tactical plays in parallel (technical QBR, executive alignment, pilot-extension commercial offer), and capture short-cycle outcomes for a QBR-ready renewal plan.
columns: Account | ARR | Contract End | Renewal Probability | Risk Profile | Next Milestone (date) | Next Step Owner | Tactical Play | Playbook Variant | Notes

assumptions: Simulation assumes 2-week sprint cadence for outreach and measurable outcomes; results roll up into QBR slides.
Playbook variants are standardized so CS reps can A/B test messaging and incentives across similar-risk cohorts.
Probability is initial internal estimate and will be updated after milestone outcomes (technical QBR, exec meeting, POC result).
simulation_notes: Priority ordering: accounts with >$300k ARR and probability drop >20pts are tagged 'wildfire' and receive combined technical+exec cadence.
Measure short-term KPIs: commit to 'Milestone Completed', 'Commercial Ask Logged', 'Legal Redlines In', measured at day+14 and day+30.
Fallback policies: if exec alignment fails, route to 'conservative commercial offer' (3-month extension + price protection) as automated play with finance approval.
